card.name: Vial contents and reconstitution wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces in injectable-drug preparation text, right before the form or strength of the vial contents, such as 'the' before lyophilized powder or 'as' before a sterile powder.

modes.label: Linking word before powder
modes.description: 'the', 'a' or 'as' just before lyophilized or sterile powder or a vial.
modes.example: Daptomycin for Injection is supplied in single-dose vials, each containing 350 mg daptomycin<< as>> a sterile, lyophilized powder.

modes.label: Space before a number in lists
modes.description: A space after a semicolon or 'with' just before a solution name or volume.

modes.label: Inside ingredient names
modes.description: Partway through a drug or excipient name in a 'Each vial contains' list.
modes.example: Each 10 mL clear glass vial contains 543 mg ganciclov<<ir>> sodium equivalent to 500 mg
